title: Community policy — Niko
doc.title: Community policy
doc.intro: These community expectations apply to every server that uses an official public Niko instance. By adding the bot to a server, the server's owners and administrators agree to uphold these standards.
s0.title: Scope and instances
s0.body:
This policy is enforced on the official public Niko instances we operate. Private, beta, and self-hosted copies are run by other people: we cannot investigate, moderate, or enforce anything on them, and reports about them cannot be handled by us. Send those to the operator of that instance.
On official instances, enforcement applies to the server and to the people involved in a violation, whether or not they are its owners.
s1.title: Purpose
s1.body: Niko is a community companion for Discord servers of all kinds. To keep the platform safe for everyone, all servers using Niko must follow the expectations below in addition to Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines. These rules apply to channels, threads, voice channels, server profiles, and anything else a server controls where Niko is present.
s2.title: Discrimination and harassment
s2.body: Servers must not permit or promote discrimination, harassment, or hate speech targeting people based on race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or any other protected identity characteristic. This includes slurs, coordinated targeting, and channels built around humiliating a person or group.
s3.title: Illegal and malicious content
s3.body: Servers must not create, host, share, or distribute illegal or malicious content. This includes, but is not limited to: child sexual abuse material (CSAM), malware and other malicious software, gore or shock content, pirated media and/or software, content that facilitates violence or terrorism, scams and phishing, and any other content that is illegal under applicable law. Niko's scam filter exists to catch the worst of this automatically; it does not replace a server's own moderation.
s4.title: Other prohibited conduct
s4.body: Servers must not use Niko to facilitate doxxing, targeted harassment campaigns, sextortion, trafficking, or the sexualization of minors in any form. Servers must not use Niko to coordinate raids, mass-reporting campaigns, or the evasion of another server's moderation.
s5.title: Enforcement and investigations
s5.body: When a server is reported or flagged for potentially violating this policy, Niko will send a warning notice to the server. The notice is followed by an investigation by Niko staff. Servers that cooperate in good faith and are found not to be breaking the policies will not receive any further action. Depending on what the investigation finds, we may warn, restrict individual features, blacklist the server, blacklist the accounts involved, or remove Niko from the server.
s6.title: Obstruction of investigations
s6.body: Banning, kicking, or otherwise removing the staff member(s) sent to investigate, or hiding, deleting, or tampering with potential evidence, is treated as an admission of guilt. Doing so will result in the server — and any users who are involved — being permanently blacklisted from further use of Niko, in addition to any other action the investigation warrants.
s7.title: Evidence and records
s7.body: During an investigation we may preserve logs, transcripts, reports, and messages relevant to it. Those records are moderation and safety records: they are kept to protect communities and are not erased by a data-removal request. They are released only under the formal legal process described in the Privacy Policy.
s8.title: Appeals
s8.body: A blacklist can be appealed once through the appeals process described in the support server. An appeal must be honest and complete; a second appeal for the same decision is not accepted, and appealing does not pause the restriction. A decision made to protect other users may stand even where a deletion request is later approved.
s9.title: Reporting
s9.body: If you believe a server using Niko is violating this policy, report it through the Niko [support server](/discord). Include the server ID and, where possible, links or message IDs. Reports are reviewed by staff and handled confidentially, and a report made in good faith will never be held against you.
